Disappointing Experience
Aug 2026 • Couples
Went there two weeks ago my lady and me as I had heard good things about the place. Was a quiet evening so sat down and ordered half rack of ribs, half a chicken, fries and Mac and cheese. Food arrived and first impression was that the food was only warm and not hot especially the fries so returned the order. After 10 minutes the food came back and we tucked in. The flavour was ok but to be honest the ribs did not have much meat on them and there was more bone and gristle than meat. For the money it was overly disappointing and we had have better BBQ in Saigon. It really failed to meet the hype.

Good but...
Mar 2025 • Couples
Would have got a rack of traditional, but was with a VN friend and thought she might prefer the other flavors, so I ordered the 4 flavor combo. Tried all except dry rub. Even my VN friend agreed, traditional was by far the best. If they sold them in St. Louis, they'd still be good. 'Sweet and spicy' Korean style wad ok but would be better with more spice and less sweet. Other two were ok.

I would give them 5 stars BUT how can you claim to be a Western style restaurant and not have salt and pepper on the table?

I've been here a few times and always seem to have the same interaction with the waitress. I ask for salt, her English isn't too good so she thinks I said 'sausce' and tells me it's already on the table. Then I have to break out google translate. She gives me a weird look like 'why do u need salt?' but says 'ok.' But then she forgets and I have to remind her when she brings my food. Now I have to sit there and stare at my food for two minutes while I wait for her to bring it. Those will most likely be the longest 2 minutes of my day. Owners, please, spare your customers this hassle. Just put salt and pepper on the table. It inot that hard to do.

BBQ. Above and beyond
Nov 2024 • Friends
Had a fantastic experience tonight at Quan Ut Ut. Googled BBQ near me and up they came. Glad they did.

2 Americans looking for a taste of home after 2 weeks of local food.

BBQ! We split - ribs, a burger, pork shoulder, grilled veggies & fries. Washed down with plenty of frosty suds!

The food was all excellent. Could not be happier.

Staff incredibly helpful. Double checked our order on their iPad to be sure all wishes were properly communicated - they were.

Perfect night out. End of the meal. Or was it?????

After we left, we were all the way down the block when we heard someone running after us? We left our phone on the table. A potential disaster.

But nope. What a wonderful lad to race down the street to return our phone.

Seriously. These guys are our heroes.

Thank you all for a wonderful night out

Excellent bbq and great value
Jun 2024 • Solo
Great quality bbq, good quality meat and large portions.

The ribs were falling off the bone and the local banh hue sausage worked really well done in the bbq style.

The Saigon fish bbq sauce is excellent, without being overly sweet.
The reaper sauce on the side was perfect - a strong chilli bite but with depth and a habanero like fruitiness which added to the flavour of the meat instead of overpowering it.

Lovely friendly staff and owner and great value for money too.

Oh dear!!
Oct 2023 • Couples
We first visited Quan Ut Ut in 2014 when we were in Saigon for 2 months and had a number of great meals there. We also returned in 2016 and once again had a great time, food, service and atmosphere were terrific. It used to be so popular we had to wait on the footpath, serviced a beer, for a table. 
We came again on Sunday, with great expectations but sorry to say it was extremely disappointing.
There were more staff than guests when we arrived, no atmosphere, and the food arrived very quickly only for it to be sent back as the ribs were at best lukewarm and not piping hot, right off the old 44 gallon drum bbq as before, nor was the corn, Mac n cheese or mash potatoes. After about 15 minutes the ribs returned at pretty much the same temperature as before, lukewarm. Also they were not fall of the bone as they use to be, not moist or really tender.
The manager did try and 'rescue' the situation by bringing us a complimentary beer each but by that stage it was too late.
Overall it was a night to forget and we won't be returning when we're next in Saigon. Very sad
